prompt: A vast, golden-hued desert landscape at dusk, bathed in warm, atmospheric light. Towering, majestic dragons with intricately armored scales and sharp horns rest on both sides of a dusty pathway, their eyes glowing with intelligence and power. A group of cloaked figures, their silhouettes elongated by the setting sun, walk in a solemn procession down the center of the path, their footprints quickly vanishing in the swirling dust. The air is thick with tension and reverence as the dragons observe the travelers, their massive wings partially unfurled, casting long, dramatic shadows across the sand. In the distance, more dragons rest near the hazy horizon, their colossal forms blending into the dusk-lit sky, while tendrils of smoke rise from unseen fires, adding an air of mystery and ancient power.
